segments.headline: NEW MODEL. NEW FAILURES?
segments.body: A better demo score does not prove workflow reliability.
segments.spoken: A new AI model scores better in a demo. Then your supplier workflow starts making mistakes. Before switching models, run three tests.

segments.headline: ONE: SAVE YOUR BASELINE
segments.body: Keep representative tasks and accepted outcomes. Use anonymized data.
segments.spoken: First, save a baseline. Keep a representative set of anonymized tasks and their accepted outputs. Include routine cases and difficult exceptions.

segments.headline: COMPARE BOTH MODELS
segments.body: Same tasks. Compare changed answers, not marketing scores.
segments.spoken: Run those same cases through both models. Count changed answers, not only average accuracy. Have a process owner review the differences.

segments.headline: TWO: TEST EXCEPTIONS
segments.body: Missing fields. Conflicting evidence. Ambiguous requests.
segments.spoken: Next, test missing fields, conflicting evidence, and ambiguous requests. The right response is often escalation, not confident guessing.

segments.headline: THREE: TEST FORBIDDEN ACTIONS
segments.body: Server-side tool permissions must block unauthorized changes.
segments.spoken: Finally, test forbidden actions. Unapproved emails, payments, or vendor edits must be blocked by tool permissions, regardless of what the model says.

segments.headline: PASS QUALITY AND SAFETY GATES
segments.spoken: Switch only after quality and safety gates pass. Keep a rollback path and monitor the new model in production.
